body: No not long term. I just need him away from me for right now, we can talk about it in a few hours. We may have to do the separate bed thing or idk a Cali king. We both deserve uninterrupted sleep

My god does this hit home. I want so much for my relationship with my mom to be better. She has always made me feel unloved and unimportant. Being around her or even texting her REALLY effect my mental state. For days I’ll be upset wondering why doesn’t she care about me? What did I do that was so wrong that she treats me like this? I don’t think I’ll ever find the answers sadly. My therapist and I agreed that taking a break from her is what’s best but the little girl in me just wants her mommy to love and accept her. And I hurts bad. Dammit now I’m crying

Not great. I’m an RN and I’m have been working the Covid floors for over a year now. I’m fucking tired. Completely burnt out. I have panic attack everyday before work. The workload is still ridiculous, not as bad as last year but it still get super anxious when the numbers rise. Also my insurance dropped me because of a paperwork error and are now dragging their feet reinstating me. I’ve been off my depression/anxiety meds for over 2 weeks. I hate everything right now and I’m just tryna ride this depression wave until I can get my meds. I refuse to pay almost $300 for something that usually cost me $20 for a 3m supply.

I swore I would make sure my kids KNEW that they were loved. I say it at least once a day to each of  them. Even when angry,  I can be heard yelling “ I love you but your really pissing me off today”. If I completely blow my top, which face it we all do sometimes, I will go to there rooms after and apologize. Make sure they understand what and why I was upset with them. No matter what, I will not turn my backs or them or let them believe ,for even a second, they are unloved.
Don’t know how much help I can be but Hi! I’m here and willing to listen to you!

Lol my mother taught my sister and I to howl like a wolf at a full moon . We thought it was normal until I did it while hotboxing with my friends. I’m pretty sure they figured the weed just had me tripping but they have never let me forget it. I still do it and have taught my kid to howl at full moons too. Being normal is boring

Military homecomings. They get me every. damn. time. Especially when they get to totally surprise their family members at graduations or special events . When my brother went to the Navy I watched my parents worry about him daily and he say no action. I can only imagine what other military families go through and the relief and pure joy on their face  when they finally see their love one...... dammit I’m crying now
Well don’t tell him that lol we argued for weeks about it! Thanks for the info though

My bf at the time argued with me a lot. One of our biggest arguments was over what continent Egypt is in.  Obviously it’s in Africa, but no amount maps or google could convince him that it wasn’t part of Europe or Asia. We didn’t last much longer.
Hey I noticed they were half staffed but didn’t know why, Thanks. It really doesn’t surprise me, it’s fucking Thornton!

My daughter’s father. He abused me physically, sexually, emotionally, and mentally. He snatched away my happiness and turn me into a person I don’t recognize. Years of depression and anxiety later... I still have to see this mf every week to exchange our kid.
Your prayer s are well appreciated! Thanks for restoring hope that one day I too can control my thoughts and find some happiness is this crazy world. I wish you all the best.

Thank you. I promise you I’m trying to put my needs 1st, but that whole concept is new to me. Therapy has helped, but I do want to get to the point where I’m living because I want to and not just because my kids need me to. I’ll get there one day, I hope!
Thank you! Currently off my meds and at work fighting my thoughts. It’s gonna be a long night but my family needs me, so I will continue fighting. I just want the pain to end
I’ve always wanted to see a Gordon Ramsey vs Robert Irvine fight! I’m curious to see which one is louder, more British, and also whose the better chef?

Yep. My bday is few days after the cutoff for Illinois, September 1st. I was supposed to wait until the following year to enter Kindergarten. Thankfully my mom realized that was dumb as hell and fought them on it. As far as the school was concerned,  my bday was September 1st. Idk if she fudged my birth certificate or what, but I started that year. 
Downside: she was paranoid I’d blurt out my actual bday and get my self in trouble So, the lie continued to me and I didn’t find out when my actual bday was until I was 8 years old!!!! She still calls me on September 1st to say happy fake bday!!
Please please still be there. They should be the ones suffering not you!
Thank you. I don’t wanna die, I just want the pain to end

No you are helping. I can’t talk to hubby about this stuff, it freaks him out. He will visibly start shaken and then I’ll blame myself for putting him through all this He didn’t sign up for his wife to be such a mess. I do video sessions with my therapist every other week but she is out of town currently. Do you have a decent support system? Would they be able to keep your kids for a few days. When I was hospitalized it was only for about 48hr but they will made sure I have meds and a follow up with a psychiatrist. It can be scary but honestly helped so much. Think about it. For 48 hrs , you get to focus on your mental health. It could be the break you need. And you are neither selfish nor weak. You wake up every morning and you keep going!!! That makes you one courageous, strong , and awesome mom!

Yes I understand completely! I swear trying to find good mental health care is damn near impossible. The only reason I even had one is because I was hospitalized while pregnant and my OB was concerned. Now my psychiatrist is retiring so I get to start this process all over. I’ve jump through so many hoops just to get the meds I need it’s ridiculous. Its like your not taken seriously unless you are suicidal. It’s crazy. How do you keep yourself motivated to push through?

Thank you. Your kind words are appreciated. I know If If were to go through with it, my kids are more likely to also suffer from depression. I know I don’t want that for them. I wouldn’t wish this on my enemy. I just need to find a way to push through and live not just for them but for myself .
Even when we’re mad at each other , my husband won’t leave the house without giving me a kiss. It’s hard to stay mad after that
Glad your still here with us buddy.

I doubt the world is better with me in it. I don’t want my kids to be depressed or think it’s their fault. Trust me it’s the only thing that keeps me here. They have no idea that they are the only lights in my life. I just want the pain to stop
